Tyler Paul Lipman / Tulane University

About

Ideas become clear
through making.

I'm Tyler Paul Lipman, a student at Tulane University focused on industrial and graphic design. I explore how materials, structure, and fabrication translate ideas into physical form.

My work moves between furniture, lighting, visual identity, and spatial design. Across these disciplines, I approach design through research, making, and refinement, with an interest in the relationship between craft, function, and narrative.

I researched how AI could fit into the company’s workflow and helped put those approaches into practice. Working with landscape architects, designers, and other team members, I translated plans, proposal details, and feedback into renderings that helped sell projects.
